description:
About this space
If you love dogs and cats, then this is the place to be. We have a beautiful garden in which you can relax and have your sundowners! It is very peaceful even though we are close to town, restaurants, shopping centers, banks and local hospitals.

The space
This room is in our house with a shared bathroom, access to the kitchen and living room areas, and a lovely outdoor eating area.

Our garden is green and lovely to relax in.

And of course the dogs and cats will be with you all day if you are around.

Guest access
You have your own room with access to a shared toilet and shower.

You also have access to our full kitchen and living room areas.

During your stay
I live in the house and am happy to tell you about the area and help you with getting settled into Bulawayo.

Our dogs and cats will certainly want to interact with you as they also live in the house with us.

Other things to note
We have two large German Shepards and two cats so you would need to be an animal lover to enjoy being here. They do have full access to the house but not to your room.
